response.sql:
WITH event_averages AS (
  SELECT
    corpeventprx,
    AVG(anlycount) AS avg_anlycount,
    AVG(ABS(inholdpct - instownpct)) AS avg_abs_ownership_diff
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals
  GROUP BY corpeventprx
),
overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_abs_ownership_diff) AS avg_of_event_differences
  FROM event_averages
)
SELECT
  e.corpeventprx,
  e.avg_anlycount,
  e.avg_abs_ownership_diff,
  e.avg_abs_ownership_diff - o.avg_of_event_differences AS difference_from_overall_average
FROM event_averages AS e
CROSS JOIN overall_average AS o
WHERE o.avg_of_event_differences IS NOT NULL;

assumptions.assumption: The plain average is an unweighted average of the per-group average absolute ownership differences, including the NULL event-type group as its own group. SQL AVG ignores missing values.

alternatives.interpretation: If “all the event types” means only named event types, exclude the NULL group from the overall benchmark while still showing it in the results.
